title: Composer and Session stream ingress
summary: Where the creator's words, attached context and approvals enter a Session, and where the Session's event stream is opened. The composer sends one turn with a client turn id and the revision it read; the stream follows the Session's events from the last event id it saw.

carrier.notes: Through the 1.0 compatibility routes (/sessions/{id}/turn and /sessions/{id}/stream), which the Gateway names for a Session (gateway.py:4153-4160). The Runtime contract's own endpoints are submit_turn and stream_events.

replaceability.why: It speaks for the creator: what it sends is the creator's message, context and approval. A replacement could act in the creator's name.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:100

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/turn
operations.notes: A turn runs the agent and may spend model budget. On E_REVISION_CONFLICT the editor syncs once and retries the same durable turn id.

bounds.name: context_refs
bounds.unit: context references per Session in the composer

invariants.text: A turn refused for a stale revision is retried once with the same client turn id, never as a new turn.

failure.notes: The stream reconnects; a turn that could not be sent is shown as such.
